docs.title: RealGazebo-ROS2
docs.text: Multi-vehicle simulation framework integrating Gazebo Harmonic, ROS2 Jazzy, PX4 SITL, ArduPilot SITL, JSBSim, Unreal Engine 5, and dora-rs.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
git clone --recursive https://github.com/vlordier/RealGazebo-ROS2.git
cd RealGazebo-ROS2
make setup          # Install dev tools + pre-commit hooks
make build-base     # Build base Docker image
make up             # Start simulation
make test           # Run all tests

docs.title: Supported Firmware
docs.text: Firmware Status Communication Use Case PX4 ✅ Production uXRCE-DDS → ROS2 Multi-rotor, VTOL, rover, boat ArduPilot ✅ Beta MAVLink → MAVROS Fixed-wing, copter, rover JSBSim ✅ Beta ROS2 topics direct High-fidelity flight dynamics

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
Gazebo Simulator ──ros_gz_bridge──▶ ROS2 ────dora-rs dataflow
       ▲                               │
       │                               ├── RealGazebo.so ──UDP──▶ UE5
       │                               └── network_sim (V2V)
       │
       └── PX4 / ArduPilot / JSBSim (vehicle containers)

docs.title: Container Architecture
docs.text: Container Purpose Base Image gazebo Physics + rendering + ROS2 bridge realgazebo:base vehicle_N PX4/ArduPilot SITL + control nodes realgazebo:base dora dora-rs dataflow (optional) realgazebo:base

docs.title: ardupilot Integration
docs.text:
vehicles:
  0:
    type: x500
    firmware: ardupilot
    spawnpoint: (0, 0, 0, 0)

docs.title: Vehicle YAML Format
docs.text:
vehicles:
  0:
    type: x500                    # Vehicle model: x500, lc_62, rover_ackermann, boat
    firmware: px4                 # Flight controller: px4, ardupilot, jsbsim
    build_target: 0               # PX4 build target index
    spawnpoint: (0, 0, 0, 0)      # (x, y, z, yaw) in NED frame

docs.title: Config Example (10 vehicles)
docs.text: See src/realgazebo/yaml/example.yaml for a complete multi-vehicle setup with: - 5 x500 quadrotors (PX4) - 1 lc_62 VTOL (PX4) - 3 rover_ackermann (ArduPilot) - 2 boats (PX4)

docs.title: Spawn Points
docs.text: Coordinates are in the NED (North-East-Down) frame relative to world origin. Yaw is in radians (-π to π).

docs.title: Validation
docs.text: Configs are validated by Pydantic when loaded. Invalid types or firmware values raise clear errors at load time.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Docker (24+)
  • Docker Compose v2
  • Git (2.40+)
  • 4 CPU cores, 8GB RAM (minimum for ARM64 native build)

docs.title: Clone
docs.text:
git clone --recursive https://github.com/vlordier/RealGazebo-ROS2.git
cd RealGazebo-ROS2

# Initialize all submodules
git submodule update --init --recursive

docs.title: Option A: Base image (ROS2 + Gazebo only, ~10 min)
docs.text: make build-base

docs.title: Option B: Full image (includes PX4 + ArduPilot, ~2 hours)
docs.text: make build-full

docs.title: Install Dev Tools
docs.text:
make setup

This installs ruff, mypy, pre-commit, and configures git hooks.

docs.title: Verify Installation
docs.text:
make test     # Run all Python tests
make lint    # Check code style
make ps      # List Docker containers

docs.title: 1. Start the Simulation
docs.text:
make up

This generates docker-compose.override.yml from the example config and starts all containers.

docs.title: 2. Monitor Startup
docs.text:
make logs     # Follow all container logs
docker compose ps  # Check container status

Gazebo takes ~30-60 seconds to load the world.

docs.title: 3. Control Vehicles
docs.text:
Open a new terminal:

# Send commands to vehicle 0
ros2 topic pub /vehicle1/manager/in/main_cmd std_msgs/String "data: ARM"
ros2 topic pub /vehicle1/manager/in/main_cmd std_msgs/String "data: OFFBOARD"

docs.title: 4. View Camera Streams
docs.text:
# View camera feed from vehicle 0 (requires display)
docker exec -it gazebo bash -c "source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && ros2 run image_viewer image_viewer --ros-args -p vehicle_num:=0 -p camera_type:=front"

docs.title: 5. Stop
docs.text: make down
